channel.title: Slopworks: Grok Bot updates and known issues
channel.description: Unofficial, fan-built project. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Grok Bot, SpaceX, or X.

item.title: Grok Bot on the iPhone Action Button
item.description: You can set Grok Bot as your iPhone's Action Button and press it to talk with your Bot. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2112252507762368684

item.title: Issue (open): Chats and drafts don't always sync to the Grok app
item.description: Two users on X reported that, using Grok Bots inside the Grok app, chats don't always sync: drafts the bot says are in the chat show up on one device or app but not the other. Second report: https://x.com/i/status/2111295921539699143 Source: https://x.com/i/status/2111250428595929141

item.title: Robinhood, Coinbase, Trello, and more connectors
item.description: Grok Bot now connects to Robinhood, Coinbase, Trello, PostHog, beehiiv, eToro, and more. Teams can also now submit connectors to the Grok Bot marketplace. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2111184284786802881

item.title: Grok Bot can read X Chat
item.description: Grok Bot can now read X Chat. Connect X, then ask it to work across your messages. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2111184282903523440

item.title: Notifications only on the device you're using
item.description: Grok Bot notifications now go only to the device you're using. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2111184281636909233

item.title: Tag @bot on X to start a task
item.description: Tag @bot in a post on X and Grok Bot gets to work on it. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2111184279938240959

item.title: Faster, more reliable voice calls
item.description: Voice calls with Grok Bot are faster, more reliable, and better at remembering past conversations. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2111184276662481202

item.title: Grok Bot is much faster
item.description: The Grok Bot team says computer tasks now finish 3x sooner on average, and replies to everything else arrive in less than half the time. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2111184275374813362

item.title: Refreshed look with a new typeface and themes
item.description: Grok Bot has a refreshed look, with a new typeface and themes. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2111184272933748980

item.title: Redesigned chat cards
item.description: Cards in Grok Bot chats have a new design with a cleaner layout, part of an update the team says improves quality, polish, and speed. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2111184270819803351

item.title: Issue (open): Plugins page lists fewer Finance accounts than are connected
item.description: A user on X reported that Grok Bot's Your plugins page shows only one of two connected Plaid finance institutions, while Grok's Connectors shows both. They said Grok Bot itself still works; only the page is wrong. Source: https://x.com/i/status/2111106317590933597

item.title: Issue (open): Convex plugin stuck on an old version
item.description: A user replying to the plugin submission post said the Convex plugin is still pinned to version 1.0.0, which ships always-on rules that take about 30k tokens of context, even though the plugin's own project fixed that. A team member acknowledged the report. Source: https://x.com/poteto/status/2110854830172557475

item.title: Plugins can be submitted
item.description: A Grok Bot team member shared that anyone can submit plugins for Grok Bot (and Grok and Cursor) through a public submission form. Source: https://x.com/poteto/status/2110840796954202186

item.title: Issue (open): Locked out during plan unification
item.description: A user on X reported being locked out of Grok Bot for about two days while moving to the unified plan. A team member replied that they are looking into it. Source: https://x.com/poteto/status/2110549555112710377

item.title: Bigger attachments, desktop notifications, and more plugin skills
item.description: Version 0.71.2 lets you attach files up to 250 MB and videos up to 1 GB, and up to 20 attachments per message. Replies notify you on your Mac or PC while you use it, Bots can use up to 200 plugin skills instead of 24, and team admins can turn off messaging between Bots. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Plus aliases for Grok Bot email
item.description: Grok Bot email supports plus aliases: send and receive with dedicated aliases, or set routines that trigger only for mail sent to one alias. Source: https://x.com/i/status/2110496237241667621

item.title: Basecamp connector launched
item.description: Basecamp announced an official Grok Bot connector, available from Connect Apps inside Grok Bot. Source: https://x.com/i/status/2110469724660441365

item.title: Issue (fixed): 404 errors on unified plan link
item.description: Users replying to the unified plan announcement got 404 errors from a shared link. A team member said the cause was mitigated. Source: https://x.com/mattyp/status/2110069342029447452

item.title: Grok Bot X Communities
item.description: The team opened applications for curated Grok Bot group chats on X for GTM, product, marketing, engineering, recruiting, and design. Source: https://x.com/poteto/status/2110029484758028732

item.title: Weekly roundup video
item.description: A team video walks through the week: Bot's own email, better X, Shopify, more color, email drafts, Bot's computer, template search, PR previews, routine right-clicks, and 5 new languages. Source: https://x.com/mattyp/status/2110009541760839701

item.title: One plan for Grok, Grok Bot, Cursor, and X
item.description: The X Subscription is one plan covering Cursor, Grok, Grok Bot, and X Premium. Every change is opt-in; if you do nothing, nothing changes. Source: https://x.com/mattyp/status/2109784144649838754

item.title: In-chat app cards, payments, and Find in page
item.description: Version 0.70.2 (which includes 0.69.0 to 0.70.1): connectors like Figma, Notion, and Canva can show an interactive app card in chat, Bots can pay with X Money or Stripe Link, and Cmd/Ctrl+F opens Find in page. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Grok Bot gets its own email
item.description: Bots can use their own email address to sign up for services, contact businesses for you, or schedule time with someone. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2108609764766908772

item.title: Shopify connector
item.description: Connect Shopify, then ask Grok Bot to check orders, track inventory, and keep product listings up to date. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2108228871938359347

item.title: Slide decks, formatted emails, and a bigger Bot screen
item.description: Version 0.68.1: Bots build slide decks and deliver them as PowerPoint or Google Slides, send formatted emails from a draft card, and work on a 1920 × 1200 computer screen, up from 1280 × 800. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Search, read, and monitor X
item.description: Grok Bot can now search, read, and monitor X. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2107949161878606089

item.title: Five more languages and Gmail send-as drafts
item.description: Version 0.68.0 adds Marathi, Tamil, Telugu, Swahili, and Hausa, and lets email drafts go out from a verified Gmail send-as address, with a From picker if you have more than one. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Marketplace becomes Connect Apps
item.description: An Oct 2 release renames Marketplace to Connect Apps, with category chips and Recommended for you first. Bot status lines use phrases like Thinking it through. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Usage limits reset
item.description: Usage limits were reset for all Grok Bot users. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2106083136002310193

item.title: Proactive suggestions
item.description: Grok Bot can now suggest ways to help without you needing to ask. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2105713240701538538

item.title: Voice chats with Team Bots, automatic updates on
item.description: Version 0.65.0 lets teammates start a voice chat with a Team Bot and turns Automatic Updates on by default (you can turn it off in Settings, Updates). Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Refreshed avatars and Secure Form logins
item.description: Version 0.64.0 refreshes Bot avatars with bigger eyes and new shapes, opens logins in a Secure Form window that names the site, and lets you turn off drafts for a Bot so it sends directly. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Better for building software
item.description: Bots can hand off coding tasks to Cursor, manage PRs with the GitHub and Origin plugins, and share video demos of what they build. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2105373767568621895

item.title: Approvals in Slack and clearer usage limits
item.description: In Slack threads, a Bot that needs approval posts a Review an action card only you can answer. When included usage runs out, the app shows the usage limit notice instead of Bot failed to respond. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Quote text and start lists in the composer
item.description: Select text and press Cmd/Ctrl+L to quote it, type - or 1. to start a list, and get spell check as you type. A Bot's info pane gains a Library tab of the pages, files, and links it has shared. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Email drafts work with Outlook
item.description: A second Sep 26 release lets you review a Bot's new email in chat and send it from your Outlook account. Wide tables in Bot messages also scroll sideways instead of squeezing. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Team Bots for a whole team
item.description: Version 0.61.0 adds Team Bots: publish one Bot for your team, and teammates chat with it in the app or Slack, each in their own conversation. Each teammate's use counts against their own allowance. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Finance integration
item.description: Link bank, card, and investment accounts with the new Finance integration, then ask Grok Bot to help manage spending and investments. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2103936247995752705

item.title: Busy Bots answer you first
item.description: When you message a busy Bot, it answers you before working through queued updates from other Bots and agents. Expired Auto-review cards also offer Always allow, and Enterprise admins can store Team Secrets. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Five more languages and better screen reader support
item.description: Czech, Danish, Finnish, Hungarian, and Norwegian Bokmål join the language list, screen readers announce more of the app, and a card explains when a usage limit, rate limit, or timeout stops a reply. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Cleaner interface
item.description: Quality-of-life update with a cleaner interface for working with your bots. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2102532697960956074

item.title: Bots can start a Project
item.description: A Bot can start a Project when you ask: a Cloud Agent that plans the work and runs its own agents. Link previews also show real titles for private Notion, GitHub, and Slack links. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Voice notes
item.description: Grok Bot can now send you voice notes. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2101014478255247544

item.title: More GitHub actions for Bots
item.description: Bots can work with GitHub releases, tags, labels, sub-issues, discussions, and collaborators, create branches, and submit one review across several files. Stopping a Bot also stops the Bots and Cloud Agents it started. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Grok Bot can talk
item.description: Grok Bot can now talk. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2100659463569170779

item.title: Regrouped setup checklist for teams
item.description: A second Sep 16 release groups the dashboard Setup Checklist into Recommended and Optional, shows the build date in About, and fixes GitHub disconnect and some 1Password sign-in checks. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: Search palette puts Bots and settings first
item.description: Version 0.54.0: Cmd/Ctrl+K shows matching Bots, settings, actions, and routines before messages (quote a search to see every message), and iPhone HEIC photos show as images. Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot

item.title: 1Password
item.description: Grok Bot can use 1Password: share items in a vault, approve each fill, and the secrets stay in your password manager. Source: https://x.com/bot/status/2100335532597502311

item.title: Uploads to Google Drive and OneDrive
item.description: Version 0.53.0: Bots can upload files to Google Drive or OneDrive or attach them to a Gmail draft, and a Bot's computer now uses your time zone. The same release added 1Password sign-in on Mac (see the 1Password entry). Source: https://x.ai/changelog/bot
